"""Hand-computed pin / revision semantics checks."""
import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
import harness

def session(transactions, groups=None, tasks=None, caps=None, query=None):
    return {"topology": ["leaf-spine", 3, 2],
            "caps": caps or [10, 10, 10, 0, 0],
            "groups": groups or [[2, 100], [2, 100]],
            "tasks": tasks or [[0, 0, 1, 0, 1], [1, 0, 1, 0, 0]],
            "query": query or {"groups": [0, 1], "nodes": [0, 1, 2], "tasks": [0, 1]},
            "transactions": transactions}

def tx(rev, edits, query=None):
    return {"revision": rev, "edits": edits,
            "query": query or {"groups": [0, 1], "nodes": [], "tasks": [0]}}

CASES = []

# P1: pinned task moved in the same transaction -> one pin violation
CASES.append(("P1 move pinned", session([tx(0, [["pin", 0, 0], ["move", 0, 1]])]),
              [{"accepted": False, "revision": 0, "violations": [0, 0, 0, 1]}, 'keep']))
# P1b: only unpinning -> allowed
CASES.append(("P1b unpin only", session([tx(0, [["pin", 0, 0]])]),
              [{"accepted": True, "revision": 1, "violations": [0, 0, 0, 0]}, 'keep']))
# P1c: after commit the task is unpinned, moving is free
CASES.append(("P1c move after unpin", session([tx(0, [["pin", 0, 0]]), tx(1, [["move", 0, 1]])]),
              [{"accepted": True, "revision": 1, "violations": [0, 0, 0, 0]},
               {"accepted": True, "revision": 2, "violations": [0, 0, 0, 0]}, 'keep']))
# P2: quota change of the old group violates the protected task
CASES.append(("P2 quota change", session([tx(0, [["quota", 0, 1]])]),
              [{"accepted": False, "revision": 0, "violations": [0, 0, 0, 1]}, 'keep']))
# P2b: same-value quota assignment is not a change
CASES.append(("P2b quota same", session([tx(0, [["quota", 0, 2]])]),
              [{"accepted": True, "revision": 1, "violations": [0, 0, 0, 0]}, 'keep']))
# P2c: quota changed back to the original inside one proposal -> no violation
CASES.append(("P2c quota toggle", session([tx(0, [["quota", 0, 1], ["quota", 0, 2]])]),
              [{"accepted": True, "revision": 1, "violations": [0, 0, 0, 0]}, 'keep']))
# P3: new group quota change does not affect a task whose old group is untouched
CASES.append(("P3 other quota", session([tx(0, [["move", 1, 1], ["quota", 1, 1]])]),
              [{"accepted": True, "revision": 1, "violations": [0, 0, 0, 0]}, 'keep']))
# P4: weight change of a protected task
CASES.append(("P4 weight", session([tx(0, [["weight", 0, 5]])]),
              [{"accepted": False, "revision": 0, "violations": [0, 0, 0, 1]}, 'keep']))
# P5: two protected tasks in the group whose quota changes
CASES.append(("P5 two pinned", session([tx(0, [["pin", 1, 1], ["quota", 0, 1]])]),
              [{"accepted": False, "revision": 0, "violations": [0, 0, 0, 0]}, 'keep']))
# P6: unpinning in the same transaction does not release protection
CASES.append(("P6 unpin+weight", session([tx(0, [["pin", 0, 0], ["weight", 0, 7]])]),
              [{"accepted": False, "revision": 0, "violations": [0, 0, 0, 1]}, 'keep']))
# P7: newly pinned task is not protected in the transaction that pins it
CASES.append(("P7 new pin", session([tx(0, [["pin", 1, 1], ["move", 1, 1]])],
                                    tasks=[[0, 0, 1, 0, 1], [1, 0, 1, 0, 0]]),
              [{"accepted": True, "revision": 1, "violations": [0, 0, 0, 0]}, 'keep']))
# P8: after commit, the newly pinned task is protected
CASES.append(("P8 new pin protects later", session([tx(0, [["pin", 1, 1]]), tx(1, [["move", 1, 1]])]),
              [{"accepted": True, "revision": 1, "violations": [0, 0, 0, 0]},
               {"accepted": False, "revision": 1, "violations": [0, 0, 0, 1]}, 'keep']))
# P9: stale revision reports null violations and keeps state
CASES.append(("P9 stale", session([tx(3, [["move", 0, 1]])]),
              [{"accepted": False, "revision": 0, "violations": None}, 'keep']))
# P10: rejection preserves state: quota change rejected, then same tx accepted
CASES.append(("P10 reject keeps", session([tx(0, [["quota", 0, 1]]), tx(0, [["quota", 0, 2]])]),
              [{"accepted": False, "revision": 0, "violations": [0, 0, 0, 1]},
               {"accepted": True, "revision": 1, "violations": [0, 0, 0, 0]}, 'keep']))
# P11: mixed group counts once per group
CASES.append(("P11 mixed", session([tx(0, [["class", 1, 3]])]),
              [{"accepted": False, "revision": 0, "violations": [0, 1, 0, 1]}, 'keep']))
# P12: work violation from load > quota*budget
CASES.append(("P12 work", session([tx(0, [["weight", 0, 100], ["weight", 1, 100]])]),
              [{"accepted": False, "revision": 0, "violations": [0, 0, 1, 2]}, 'keep']))
# P13: over-capacity node count
CASES.append(("P13 capacity", session([tx(0, [["cap", 0, 1], ["cap", 1, 0]])]),
              [{"accepted": False, "revision": 0, "violations": [2, 0, 0, 1]}, 'keep']))
# P14: no-op transaction with matching revision is accepted
CASES.append(("P14 noop", session([tx(0, [])]),
              [{"accepted": True, "revision": 1, "violations": [0, 0, 0, 0]}, 'keep']))
# P15: pin violation counted once even when several fields differ
CASES.append(("P15 once", session([tx(0, [["weight", 0, 9], ["class", 0, 4], ["bind", 0, 3]])]),
              [{"accepted": False, "revision": 0, "violations": [0, 1, 0, 1]}, 'keep']))
# P16: protected task moving away, old group quota also changes -> still one
CASES.append(("P16 move+quota", session([tx(0, [["move", 0, 1], ["quota", 0, 1]])]),
              [{"accepted": False, "revision": 0, "violations": [0, 0, 0, 1]}, 'keep']))
# P17: protected task moving away, new group quota changes -> not its old group
CASES.append(("P17 move new quota", session([tx(0, [["move", 0, 1], ["quota", 1, 1]])]),
              [{"accepted": True, "revision": 1, "violations": [0, 0, 0, 0]}, 'keep']))


def expected_certificate(sess, outcome, index):
    """The certificate is checked through the reference model instead of by hand."""
    return None


def main():
    import ref
    failures = 0
    for name, sess, outcomes in CASES:
        request = {"version": 2, "sessions": [sess]}
        p = harness.run_request(request)
        if p.returncode != 0:
            print(f'{name}: rc={p.returncode} {p.stderr.decode()[:300]}'); failures += 1; continue
        got = harness.strict_load(p.stdout)
        if 'error' in got:
            print(f'{name}: engine invalid {got}'); failures += 1; continue
        txouts = got['sessions'][0]['transactions']
        exp_ref = ref.run(request)
        if len(txouts) != len(outcomes):
            print(f'{name}: count mismatch {len(txouts)}'); failures += 1; continue
        ok = True
        for i, (want, actual) in enumerate(zip(outcomes, txouts)):
            for key, value in want.items():
                if actual[key] != value:
                    print(f'{name}[{i}]: {key} expected {value} got {actual[key]}')
                    ok = False
        if not harness.same(got, exp_ref):
            print(f'{name}: reference mismatch\n got={json.dumps(got)[:600]}\n exp={json.dumps(exp_ref)[:600]}')
            ok = False
        if not ok:
            failures += 1
    print('pin/revision cases:', len(CASES), 'failures', failures)
    return 1 if failures else 0

if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())
